parameters.bindable: the native_parameters rows of inspect (sketch dimensions, Length, Offset, Angle, helix Pitch/Height/Radius, Radius, Size, Thickness, Hole Diameter/Depth/PointAngle)

excluded.rebuild: Whole-document revalidation; every step already rebuilds

references.$ref: the created feature of an earlier step with that "as" alias
references.$part: the single output part id of an earlier step with that "as" alias

batch.validation: per-step gates, then result checks once before the commit

length.description: Millimetres: a finite number, or a length quantity string with units and arithmetic such as "1/8 in" or "12.7/2"

positive_length.description: Positive millimetres: a number or a length quantity string

angle.description: Radians: a finite number, or an angle quantity string such as "90 deg"

positive_angle.description: Positive radians, or an angle quantity string such as "180 deg"

number.description: Unitless finite number (booleans are not numbers)

direction3.description: Nonzero [x, y, z] direction; normalized, so it need not be unit length

axis.description: World line {origin, direction}; each key may be omitted (origin [0,0,0], direction [0,0,1])

feature.description: Name (stable ID) of an existing native object, as inspect reports it

new_id.description: Name for the created native object: an ASCII letter, then up to 63 letters, digits or underscores; an existing name rejects with duplicate_feature

assembly_id.description: Name for the created assembly object: an ASCII letter, then letters, digits or underscores (invalid_id otherwise; an existing name rejects with duplicate_id)

part.description: Current logical part: its id (inspect studio.parts[].id) or its Body name

body.description: PartDesign Body name or logical part id that receives the new work; optional when the target, support or profile owns one, or when the document has a single current part (ambiguous_body otherwise)

expression.description: Native dimensional formula over named properties and arithmetic, such as "PlateProfile.Constraints.Width / 10"

selector.description: Authored geometry query; x-kinds lists each kind's allowed keys. Unknown keys reject with invalid_selector

subelement.description: Native element name FaceN, EdgeN or VertexN

native_reference.description: Explicit native element of a feature's shape

reference.description: One geometry element: {feature, subelement}, a bare selector, or {selector}

multi_reference.description: Every matching edge of the current part, re-evaluated at each managed rebuild

support.description: Planar support: {feature} for a datum plane, {feature, subelement:"FaceN"} for a planar face of a solid in the same Body, or a face selector

merge_scope.description: "auto" (parts the tool touches; contact counts for Add) or the target parts

result_operation.description: new makes an independent part; add/remove/intersect combine with the merge scope

subelement.description: "" for the occurrence origin, or an analytic FaceN, line/circle EdgeN or VertexN

assembly_reference.description: Joint connector on an assembly occurrence

batch.summary: Run 1-32 modeling steps as one native transaction: one undo step and one revision change, or nothing at all when any step or the final result check fails

document_id.description: Document UUID from inspect or list_documents

expected_revision.description: Current revision; a stale or missing value rejects with stale_revision

measure.description: Measurement level of the returned inspection; explicit null rejects

request_id.description: Required through the bridge for retry identity; optional headless

label.description: Names the undo step: KurtShape: batch <label>

steps.description: Each step is a modeling request without envelope fields, plus an optional alias "as"; {"$ref": alias} stands for that earlier step's created feature and {"$part": alias} for its single output part, as whole values

constraints: Steps run in order through the single-operation gates; result checks run once before the commit, so a later step may repair an earlier one
A failure names the step (error.batch.step, phase step or final_validation) and rolls everything back
Not batchable: every operation outside MODEL_OPS and capabilities.batch.excluded
Preview with proposal {op: batch, steps, label?} first; accepted means the commit would succeed

create_parameter.summary: Create a model parameter (length, angle or number) with a value, a formula over other parameters, or by promoting existing dimensions (bind)

document_id.description: Document UUID from inspect or list_documents

expected_revision.description: Current revision; a stale or missing value rejects with stale_revision

measure.description: Measurement level of the returned inspection; explicit null rejects

request_id.description: Required through the bridge for retry identity; optional headless

bind.description: Dimensions (inspect native parameters) to drive by the new parameter; without value or expression they must agree and give the value

expression.description: Formula over other parameters only (bare or Params.<name>)

name.description: Starts with a lowercase letter, e.g. shaft_diameter; also not a unit, constant, function or attribute of the set (invalid_parameter_name)

type.description: length (mm), angle (rad on the wire, stored in degrees) or number; inferred from bind targets, a quantity string or the formula's unit when omitted

value.description: Wire units (mm, rad, unitless) or a quantity string such as "15 deg"

constraints: At most one of value and expression; one of value, expression or bind
Bind targets must be driving, not formula-driven, and of the parameter's unit
One managed rebuild for any number of bind targets

none.description: No document is needed; nothing is open

plate.description: Legacy single-Body plate: a 60 x 40 x 6 mm Pad with a through Pocket of 8 mm diameter, plus unconsumed sketches BossProfile (6 mm circle at 10, 10 on XY), Crossing (a line on XZ crossing the XY plane at x 2) and Target (XY, holding one free native point at 4, 0 as geometry 0, added outside typed operations because no typed sketch-point operation exists)

studio.description: Part Studio with parts Body (40 x 30 x 10 block) and Tool (10 mm cube at x 35..45, y 10..20, overlapping it), plus unconsumed sketches BossProfile, RingProfile (XZ rectangle at x 60), PathSketch (line along +X at y -20), SweepProfile (YZ circle at the path start), LoftLower and LoftUpper (on datum plane LoftPlane, 20 mm above XY)

assembly.description: Assembly of three occurrences of the plate fixture's Body: Base (grounded), Rotor (revolute joint Hinge to Base) and Free (unconstrained)

x-example-placeholders.<project>: an empty folder inside a granted project folder
x-example-placeholders.<plate_file>: the plate fixture saved as an FCStd file that is not open
x-example-placeholders.<step_file>: the plate fixture exported as STEP
x-example-placeholders.<recovery_manifest>: a forced checkpoint manifest of the plate fixture in the session's project-recovery folder
